title: Order-to-Cash
description: Mockup of one Order-to-Cash case: Claude builds the case file with proof lines, the Joule agent reads the S/4 document flow, and a person releases each correction within their own limits. Fictional sample data.
insights: Case file: Claude reads emails, delivery note and contract; every finding carries the line it rests on, inferences are marked.
S/4 document flow shows the two gaps: 40 of 200 pieces are not invoiced (billing block) and the invoice uses the standard price instead of the contract price.
Proposals: nothing is written until a person releases it. Switch between the sales clerk and the team lead to see the credit memo limit at work.
Fictional sample data. No SAP system is called; tool names and document numbers are illustrative.
prompt: Bundled example: Order-to-Cash (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
